$comment: Maps each user-visible Paychex customization (and the upstream surfaces it depends on)
to a selector VERIFIED against a live environment, not inferred from source.
verified: 'probe' = resolved by e2e/specs/probe/selectors.probe.spec.ts against n2a.
'dump'  = observed in the accessible-name enumeration against n2a.
'no'    = still a guess; must be confirmed before a journey test relies on it.
Regenerate ground truth: gh workflow run e2e-tests.yml -f environment=n2a -f suite=probe

customizations.what: PendoInitializer wraps AuthLayout; SDK loaded for authenticated session
Paychex Changelog entry inside the account menu
Paychex Changelog link in the footer, beside the LibreChat version link
customizations.note: Footer also exposes a 'LibreChat v0.8.7' link — useful as a version assertion after upgrades.

customizations.what: Prompt Catalog panel entry in the side nav
customizations.note: #prompt-catalog does NOT exist. An earlier source-derived guess was wrong.

customizations.what: ?promptCatalogId= resolves server-side and inserts the prompt; failure shows a toast
customizations.selector: UNVERIFIED — requires a valid catalog id on n2a

customizations.what: ToolsDropdown items render a description line under each label
customizations.note: Trigger is named 'Tools Options', NOT 'Tools'. Per-item description markup still unverified.

customizations.what: Attach-file menu items render helper descriptions (e.g. 'Add an image for analysis.')
customizations.note: Do NOT locate by /attach file/i — it also matches the 'Attach Files' nav panel and trips strict mode.

customizations.what: Star + DEFAULT badge on the model spec flagged default:true (azure-gpt-5.4-mini on n2a)
customizations.note: Badge renders '★ DEFAULT' in ONE span, so getByText('DEFAULT', {exact:true}) can never match; use the aria-label. Opening the model menu showed only endpoint entries (endpoint-*-menu) — the modelSpec list was not reached, so the badge is still unconfirmed.
